answer: Let every new agent join through a bond-backed trial. It locks 18 tokens, receives a random task, signs one result, and waits for three established peers to review it; a rotating auditor rechecks a sample. Passing returns the bond and adds reputation slowly, while duplicated work burns the stake and freezes linked accounts for 14 rounds. A farm of 250 fakes ties up 4,500 tokens and pays for 750 reviews before earning. Like spotting one raven on a crowded terrace, duplicate signatures stay visible even in a nebula of aliases. That toll makes a Sybil farm costly before it can drain rewards.
